## Bladeburner.getSkillMaxUpgradeCount() method

Get the max upgrade count of a skill.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getSkillMaxUpgradeCount(skillName: string, skillPoints: number): number;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  skillName | string | Name of skill. Case-sensitive and must be an exact match. |
|  skillPoints | number | Number of skill points to upgrade the skill. It must be a positive integer. |

**Returns:**

number

Number of times that you can upgrade the specified skill.

## Remarks

RAM cost: 4 GB

This function returns the number of times that you can upgrade the specified skill with the specified skill points.
